user.title: User Profile
user.description: Public profile and authentication mapping for a user

photoURL.description: URL to the user's Google profile picture

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp of the user account

feedback.title: Place Feedback
feedback.description: Vote and comment annotations for a specific OpenStreetMap venue

placeName.description: The name of the spot at the time of voting

vote.description: Thumbs up ('up') or Thumbs down ('down') vote

updatedAt.description: When the vote or comment was last updated

recentSearch.title: Recent Search
recentSearch.description: A geocoded query visited by the user

query.description: The input text entered by the user

label.description: The main city or location name

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp of when the search was executed

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user accounts containing general metadata

/users/{userId}/feedbacks/{feedbackId}.description: Private place suitability reviews and votes curated by the user

/users/{userId}/recentSearches/{searchId.description: Geographical search queries made by the user, ordered by time
